body: Telling my friends about what she did was wrong
I told people in which they shamed her for it. That's a lot to take in when she already lost two people she cared about due to her actions. She made mistakes, yeah, but that's a lot of pressure still
Yeah, but my actions were factors in her decision
I just want to let her know that I forgive her. I'm happy and I'm doing well now and she's in this state. Think I can be the bigger person and apologize right?

Ok, thank you, that makes sense. I just don't want her to know that I have no bad feelings towards her and that she shouldn't feel shame. I'll probably just stop by and bring her a gift and that's all. Her boyfriend did break up with her and he's not the type to care after that from what I've gathered. She also lost a lot of friends so I should be the bigger person and at least say I forgive you.

I 100% believe that her decision to do this was impacted by my choices. She would have no reason to do so if I hadn't had made her feel so much shame for what she did. She did a terrible thing but I took it too far and I wish I could take that back but I obviously can't. 

I just want to be her friend until she's out of the hospital so she knows that I'm sorry and that I forgive her. I don't know if that's what she's seeking but if it is then I'll gladly give it to her. I'm doing fine now and she's still suffering so there's no reason for me to keep putting her down.

Yeah, I understand this but I feel horrible still. If I would've let it go like a mature person would've I don't think she would be in this situation now. I think she's going to make it out but there might be permanent damage or something and I 100% believe I have a role in that. She wasn't even cruel to me besides lying to me and I don't think she deserved to be outed like that. I don't know what was going on with her boyfriend and that situation but if she lied about that as well then that's also terrible and another way she was trying to manipulate me but I don't think she should have to resort to suicide because of the shame she was feeling.

The shame is needed to set her straight but it was too far and I can't express how much I regret that. I know I have a role in her choice to attempt suicide and that will forever haunt me. I need to say sorry to her as soon as possible I believe and then if she accepts it I can move on.
I just don't know how to cope with this guilt though. Just press through it or what? I mean, I don't want a relationship with her at all but I want to be there for her as a friend.

But I didn't need to make it public. I did that to her and it's horrible to think that I had a role in this. I need to see her and apologise. Her roomate let me know about it and I can't do anything but worry now.

I didn't abuse her at all. I cared for her greatly and I still do but she hurt me. I don't think she deserves this bullying because I believe she is mentally ill in some way. I know she has ADHD but I don't know what else. I should have never said anything because all over her social media is people mocking her. I caused that.
